title: Hyper Farm
features:
Version: v1
Free Version

Auto-Trainers - Automatically farms FS, BT, and PS stats with intelligent area progression based on your power level

Auto Box & Merge - Automatically opens Tier1 boxes and merges items for efficient inventory management

Soul Orb Collector - Instantly teleports all Soul Orbs to your position for immediate collection

Flag Capture System - Auto-captures both Normal and TPM flags with 100% success rate using multiple attempts

Player Attack - Target and eliminate specific players with teleport, shoot, and return mechanics

Nuker - Automatically hunts and eliminates Phantom, Sath, and Robot NPCs

Auto Quest - Automatically completes daily and weekly quests

Overseer Farm - Continuously shoots Energy Spheres at the Overseer boss

Real-time Stats - Displays current stats, fusion progress, and 1-hour TP projections

Smart Teleports - Quick teleport to any training area with organized sections
